name: GitHub
author: Dan Jones
description: A keyboard-friendly GitHub inbox for notifications, reviews, your own pull requests, assigned issues, and Actions.

barWidget.description: Act on unread notifications and browse review requests, your authored pull requests with their check state, assigned issues, and active workflows.

schema.label: Live Actions poll (seconds)
schema.description: How often to refresh Actions while a watched workflow is running. 0 disables the live poll.

schema.label: Open links
schema.description: Open links in a browser tab, or in a dedicated web app window. The web app window requires a Chromium-based default browser.
